title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta55

- Changes the integration-owned Navimower Schedule switch from destructive enable/disable semantics to reversible pause/resume semantics.
- Preserves scheduler runtime, active-zone ownership, queue progress and retained interruption state while Schedule is off.
- On re-enable, safely adopts an unfinished retained task from Notification Center when the task belongs to the scheduler allowlist, so Resume / continue (`reset=false`) is used instead of accidentally starting the zone again with `reset=true`.
- Adds `navimower.reset_schedule` as the explicit destructive scheduler action. It clears the current scheduler round/queue state without sending a mower command and is refused while the mower is mowing or returning.
- Keeps normal `reset=true` behavior only for a genuinely new scheduler zone-cycle after the previous task has completed or after an explicit schedule reset.
